title: lastreopsis chontalensis
intro: Lastreopsis chontalensis, commonly known as Chontalensis fern, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing fever, alleviating pain, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Lastreopsis chontalensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
